answer: The nectar decay curve is applied at each close, pulse records the drop, and glacier recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks hence finds them worthless when it returns to them. Standing decays sharply after 6 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The attacker spends 134 dollars and 17 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
